UI_MinidoracatCapsule_NeedFramework: This window needs Minidoracat UI Framework (API rev 18 or later).
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_PreviewHint: Left drag: rotate · right drag: pan · wheel: zoom · double-click: reset
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_PreviewNote: The 3D view shows this vehicle type's default look with every optional part. This vehicle's actual state is in the list above.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_ScriptMissing: The mod of this vehicle type is not loaded.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_CannotDraw: This vehicle type cannot be drawn in 3D.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_OptShowDock: Show the admin panel in the family Dock
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_OptShowDock_toolti: Only admins see it. Turn off to hide the Universal Capsule button from the Dock.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_Why_CAR_EXISTS: The server has the recorded vehicle loaded: it is still in the world.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_Why_CHECK_SITE: Go to the spot first, then tick "I checked on site".
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_Why_NOT_RESTORABLE: This record cannot be restored in its current state.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_Why_NOT_UNCERTAIN: This record is no longer unconfirmed.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_Why_BLOCKED: Nothing can appear on the chosen spot (not loaded or blocked). Pick another spot.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_Why_PICK_BLOCKED: It does not fit on the chosen spot. Pick another one.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_Why_BAD_SPOT: The chosen spot is not valid. Pick it again.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_Why_IN_TRADE: This capsule is in an Economy trade (listed or up for auction). Cancel the listing or wait for the auction to end first.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_Why_SCRIPT_MISSING: This vehicle type no longer exists (was its mod removed?).
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_Why_NO_SNAPSHOT: There is no record file for this capsule.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_Why_WRITE_FAILED: The server could not write the record file.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_Why_BAD_TRANSITION: This change is not allowed in the current state.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_Why_ERROR: Server error; see the server log.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_SearchHint: Capsule number or player, e.g. 10023114, Bob
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_NoteHint: Note (optional), e.g. reissued the water bottles
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_PickRecord: Pick a record on the left.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_UncertainHelp: check on site: still there = close it, gone = restorable
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_CarLoaded: vehicle #%1 is loaded on the server
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_RestoreConfirm: Restore %1 at (%2, %3)? It comes back without cargo (the record lists it), and the old capsule can never be unpacked afterwards.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_LootNote: Only containers opened for the first time afterwards are affected; containers already looted do not respawn. The numbers go straight into the vanilla loot tables. Which types drop is set on the Types tab; they share each place's weight.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_NoSandboxRight: You need the sandbox options permission to change these.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_LootApplied: Changes sent: %1. The server updates the loot tables within a second.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_SettingsNote: Same values as this mod's pages in the vanilla sandbox options; they take effect as soon as the server receives them.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_TypeUseTip: Off: players cannot pack vehicles or animals with this type. Loaded capsules of it still throw and unpack.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_TypeLootTip: On: empty capsules of this type turn up in loot, sharing each place's weight with the other types that are on.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_TypeListTip: Opens a product draft for this empty capsule in the Economy Center shop; set the price there.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_TypeListNoEconomy: Needs Minidoracat Economy to list it.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_TypePreviewTip: Throws one capsule of this type beside you. Only you see it, and it works before you apply.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_TypeOffLine: Off: cannot pack; loaded ones still throw
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_TypesNote: Loot: the %1 types that are on share each place's weight. Places and weights are on the Loot tab.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_TypesNoteNone: No type turns up in loot now.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_ShopOpened: Opened a product draft for %1 in the Economy Center. Set its price and apply it there.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_ShopOpen_forbidden: You do not have Economy Center admin rights.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_ShopOpen_unavailab: The Economy Center admin window is not ready; try again later.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_ShopOpen_other: The Economy Center did not open the product draft.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_RestoreAnimalConfi: Restore %1 at (%2, %3)? The old capsule can never be unpacked afterwards.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_AnimalLoaded: animal #%1 is near its recorded spot on the server
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_AnimalNotLoaded: animal #%1 is not near its recorded spot
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_Why_ANIMAL_EXISTS: The recorded animal is still near its recorded spot: it is still in the world.
UI_MinidoracatCapsule_Why_SAFEHOUSE: The chosen spot is in someone else's safehouse. Pick another one.
